page.overview:
Who is The Tyrant?

The Tyrant is a character from Final Fantasy XIV, introduced in the expansion Dawntrail. He is the grand champion of the Ascension Arcadia Championship.

The Tyrant is a tan-skinned Eldite with grey hair and white-grey and red jacket, trousers and boots.

When fused with the feral soul of a behemoth, he maintains his general outlook, added with long behemoth horns, tail and behemoth fur as hair.

The Tyrant is a fierce warrior, who appears intimidating. But he is also honorable, as he despises it when his fellow heavyweight fighters ambush the Warrior of Light outside the arena with their feral souls.
